name: @exasol-studio/exasol-sql-parser
description: Exasol SQL grammar (ANTLR) with caret code-completion — standalone, extractable

scripts.generate: antlr4ng -Dlanguage=TypeScript -o src/generated -visitor -listener -Xexact-output-dir src/grammar/ExasolLexer.g4 && antlr4ng -Dlanguage=TypeScript -o src/generated -visitor -listener -Xexact-output-dir -lib src/generated src/grammar/ExasolParser.g4 && node scripts/postgen.mjs
